verdict.rationale: Lambda's core product is a GPU cloud/IaaS compute service (On-Demand Cloud, 1-Click Clusters, Managed Kubernetes/Slurm) that is inherently delivered on Lambda's own data-center hardware; there is no software artifact a customer could instead run on their own infrastructure. Self-hosting is a category error for a cloud compute provider, similar to asking whether AWS EC2 can be self-hosted — even Private Cloud (docs-19) is dedicated hardware operated by Lambda, not customer self-hosting of Lambda's software.
